purpose: Determine whether independently published historical DOF/BirdLife Sterna paradisaea GBIF occurrences carry explicit breeding/nesting evidence and spatial uncertainty sufficient for eventual source-site/year matching; do not yet crosswalk original tern movements.

source_sample_design.method: Deterministic fixed pages only, NOT random or representative, 100 records at offsets 0, floor(count/2), count-100 for each verified window
source_sample_design.reproducibility: Do not interpret 15 first/middle/last pages as a statistical sample or stable historic snapshot; raw query response hashes and page count saved.

field_quality_bins.breeding_semantics: NO BREEDING CLAIM based on nonempty behavior/reproductiveCondition/remarks fields at this stage. These fields must be inspected and their codes independently defined in new protocol.
field_quality_bins.protect_remarks: Only count nonempty occurrences, never output raw text or tokens, values could include names/locations.
field_quality_bins.site_year_date: Count year/eventDate presence but do not treat as evidence of historical database availability.
field_quality_bins.sensitive_sites: If uncertainty >=20000m, refuse direct km-scale source matching in later stages. Missing uncertainty is UNKNOWN, not precise.
field_quality_bins.record_identity: Count nonempty IDs and duplicate occurrence IDs across frozen pages; never output IDs.

gates: GBIF results from source UUID only, speciesKey must match exactly 5229230 (or STOP for ambiguous subspecies), countryCode == DK, hasCoordinate true
All 15 response.count values must equal source count receipt's five predeclared totals
Exactly 100 original result entries in each frozen page (expected counts all >=100)
Original observation fields may be missing; report counts and STOP_BEHAVIOR_SCHEMA_ABSENT if no fields permit breeding evidence, but do not retry nonfrozen samples
Do not make any source-colony crosswalk, no source/current-year occupation verification or EOG-WF new scored endpoint
No eBird, no TinyFish, no different provider data substituted.
next_stage_requires: Explicit independently auditable breeding/nesting semantic code and coordinate-uncertainty quality plus year. Need a separate stage3 protocol for actual location crosswalk, even if these schema fields are present.
